question: Which Indian organization organized the 19th India Digital Summit in January 2025, highlighting the digital ecosystem?

options.text: National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM)
Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **19th India Digital Summit** was organized by the **Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI)** in **January 2025**. This summit is one of the largest events in the digital industry in India.
 
• IAMAI is a non-profit organization that represents the digital services industry in India. It was established in **2004** and plays a significant role in shaping policies and promoting the growth of the digital economy.
 
• The summit is a platform that brings together industry leaders, government officials, startups, and other stakeholders to discuss the latest trends, challenges, and opportunities in the **digital ecosystem**. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• The event also highlights innovations in areas like **technology, e-commerce, fintech, digital payments, and internet services**, making it a key event for the sector.
 
• The 19th edition of the India Digital Summit focused on the theme of **digital transformation**, which is a critical aspect of India's growing economy. *Hence, this statement is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI):**

 
 
• IAMAI was founded in **2004** and is headquartered in **Mumbai, India**.
 
• It aims to expand and enhance the online and mobile value-added services sectors.
 
• IAMAI represents a range of industries, including **online and mobile content providers, e-commerce platforms, digital advertising firms, fintech companies, and cloud computing services**.
 
 
 
• **Other Relevant Organizations:**
 
 
• **National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM):** Established in **1988**, NASSCOM is a trade association of the Indian Information Technology (IT) and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) industry.
 
• **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI):** Founded in **1997**, TRAI regulates the telecommunications sector in India, ensuring transparency and fair competition.
 
• **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII):** Established in **1895**, CII is a non-government, non-profit organization that works to create a conducive environment for the growth of industry in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Digital Summits:**

 
 
• Digital summits like the India Digital Summit play a crucial role in bringing together key stakeholders in the technology and digital sectors to discuss industry trends, challenges, and future prospects.
 
• These events also provide a platform for showcasing innovations and developments, fostering collaborations, and influencing policy decisions in favor of the industry.
 
 
 
• **India's Digital Transformation:**
 
 
• India has been making significant strides in digital transformation, with initiatives like **Digital India** aimed at improving online infrastructure and increasing internet connectivity to make the country digitally empowered.
 
• The rapid growth of smartphone penetration and internet usage in India has created a massive opportunity for businesses in sectors like **e-commerce, digital payments, and technology**.
